item.title: ✖️ Chris Perruna $GOOGL & $SPCX Alphabet increased its holding by approximately
item.description:
✖️ Chris Perruna

$GOOGL & $SPCX

Alphabet increased its holding by approximately 3.85 million shares during the third quarter, bringing its total to 555.0 million shares (up from 551.2 million shares at the end of the second quarter).

• The stake represents roughly 4.1% to 4.2% of SpaceX and accounts for approximately 95% of Alphabet's non-core investment portfolio.

• At a recent share price closing around $134.27, the market value of Alphabet's position is worth over $74 billion to $83.7 billion (fluctuating with SpaceX's post-IPO market volatility).
